one_line_answer.text: SMART goals are: S- Specific, M- Measurable, A- Achievable, R- Relevant/Realistic, T- Time-referenced.

S- Specific. M- Measurable. A- Achievable.
R- Relevant/Realistic.

bangla_explanation: শুধু 'আমি করব' বললে goal হয় না; professional হিসেবে goal হতে হবে specific আর focused।
প্রতিষ্ঠানের goals থেকে নিজের personal performance goals বানান, সেগুলোও SMART হবে।
Achievable মানে নিজের ওপর অবাস্তব চাপ দেবেন না; Time referenced মানে সময়সীমা দিয়ে progress মাপবেন।
সাধারণত short term goals, long term goals-এর আগে priority পায়।

example.en: A trainer wants to speak better in public. She works with a colleague one hour a week. She rates her skill before and after, by August.
example.bn: কী (specific), কীভাবে মাপবেন (measurable), সময় আছে কি না (achievable), কেন দরকার (relevant), কবে শেষ (time)।

mnemonic.text: SMART = Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant/Realistic, Time-referenced

list_answer.title: SMART goals: what each letter means

cites.quote: S- Specific.
M- Measurable.

items.text: A- Achievable: you shouldn't place unrealistic demands on yourself.

cites.quote: A- Achievable. You shouldn't place unrealistic demands on yourself

items.text: R- Relevant/Realistic: aligned with your responsibilities, accountabilities and aspirations.

cites.quote: R- Relevant/Realistic. Any goal should be aligned with your individual responsibilities and accountabilities as well as your own aspirations.

items.text: T- Time-referenced: time limits help measure the goal's progress.

cites.quote: T- Time-referenced. Time limits help with the measurement of the goal's progress.

items_bn: Specific — নির্দিষ্ট; ঠিক কী করবেন তা পরিষ্কার করে বলা, অস্পষ্ট নয়।
Measurable — মাপা যায় এমন, যাতে বোঝা যায় goal কতটা পূরণ হলো।
Achievable — অর্জন করা সম্ভব; নিজের ওপর অবাস্তব চাপ দেবেন না।
প্রাসঙ্গিক ও বাস্তবসম্মত — নিজের responsibilities, accountabilities আর aspirations-এর সাথে মিল থাকতে হবে।
Time-referenced — সময়সীমা থাকবে; সময় বাঁধা থাকলে goal-এর progress মাপা যায়।

traps.text: Achievable also means: take account of other demands on your time.

cites.quote: remember to take account of other demands on your time and factors that may affect achievement.

traps.text: Goals for your current position come before goals for future positions.

cites.quote: Goals related to your current position would be given priority over those related to future positions.

short.modelAnswer:
SMART goals are:
1. S- Specific
2. M- Measurable
3. A- Achievable: no unrealistic demands on yourself
4. R- Relevant/Realistic: aligned with your responsibilities, accountabilities and aspirations
5. T- Time-referenced: time limits help measure progress
Personal performance goals should also be expressed as SMART goals.

keyPoints.text: Use institutional goals to devise personal performance goals. Express them as SMART goals.

cites.quote: You can use these institutional level goals to devise your own personal performance goals.
These should also be expressed as SMART goals.

keyPoints.text: As a professional, you need to be specific and focused.

cites.quote: As a professional, you need to be more specific and focused than that.

keyPoints.text: Short-term goals would be given priority over long-term ones.

cites.quote: short-term goals would be given priority over long-term ones.

keyPoints.text: SMART goals do not need to be just about formal courses.
